## C044 closed: current-P23 angular/cache census published

Owner `interactive-reach06-p23-angular-census-20261026-c044-63c8` closes C044 on `work/reach06-p23-angular-census-20261026-c044`.

**Draft PR [#41](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/pull/41)** is open, unmerged and stacked on C043 PR #40. Final commit **`91e8899ad90f04292dd4aee5aaec8b730b397d45`**, exact tree **`11d1ce9acc2cb4fa93be44c4772a9e8e3b3270ff`**. Core evidence is `725397be68153f27eaa128b1163bdfc3636e99c6`, tree `d3a5609a2b39b0c3577b2d3065cfcbf65192bc51`; the child appends actual validation and independent review.

### Actual result

Complete original checkout recovery passes: **2,265 files / 477,942,773 bytes** at C043's exact published commit/tree. Both fresh unchanged P23 requests retain failed status / exit 1 at **100,001 shared / 80,801 completed reach operations**. All 222 category totals, original diagnostic and failure frames, complete recorded post-state and compared cache state agree. Product elapsed is **2.303072430 s stock / 10.730872985 s capture**; no elapsed or general-path neutrality is claimed.

The census records **32 completed cold envelopes** at exact first sample **1/26**, index 0, both selectors false, with **one exact angular signature (t=2, c=15, same sq)** and **32 distinct spatial/whole-key signatures**. Original envelopes cost **960 charges**; the 991-charge batch includes 31 intercall charges. There are **434 conditional gross repeated angular sites**, with no eligible candidate-hit count, net-saving bound, candidate-retention result, unseen-tail cost or P23 pass inferred.

Independent replay reconciles **46,721 events / 6,177 completed cache mutations**. All 32 original whole entries survive without later access. The final lookup refuses before membership; replay's separate finding that its equal key is retained does not make it a hit or miss.

### Verified publication and qualifications

The unchanged documentation checker passes on the actual published core: **29 sources / 233 sections / 193 documents / 1,593 local links / 90 anchors**, zero failures. All core inputs are stable.

Nine archive parts reconstruct **6,401,045 bytes**, SHA-256 `53406dbde80cb37af0930f37385e03f6b8282ca9c23d020a30a5fdcb891b37a7`. Independent final review verifies all **99 members / 49,758,827 bytes**, CRCs, paths, hashes, modes and the actual restored nanosecond modification times; 41 reference bindings resolve. The unknown partial file remains preserved with unknown origin. Defined credential scans found no matching authentication material. Two audit-script preparation failures remain preserved with their original scripts/logs and corrections.

The actual **17:25:13.341049Z** product launch preceded the mistakenly declared **17:26:00Z** start. Both exact reviews, source closure and recorded pause commitments preceded launch, but the nominal start condition was not met. Original declaration6422796063, correction6422806731 and command receipts remain unchanged; no repeat or backdating occurred.

Final readback verifies **all 2,356 files / 490,821,760 bytes** against remote blobs/modes/sizes, exact final Git commit/tree and clean local publication state. All **2,282 core files**, all **2,265 original parent files**, all **89 prior branch heads**, and main `2bb4588e121fcfe99b4d42c734b15b38362f3642` are preserved. All 20 open PRs remain drafts; GitHub reports zero Actions runs for the final head. No hosted job, merge, runtime change or shared STATUS edit occurred.

### Handoff and ownership release

Read [HANDOFF-044](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/91e8899ad90f04292dd4aee5aaec8b730b397d45/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/HANDOFF-044.md), the [report](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/91e8899ad90f04292dd4aee5aaec8b730b397d45/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-044-angular-census.md) and [actual validation](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/91e8899ad90f04292dd4aee5aaec8b730b397d45/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-044-validation.json).

**Next: C045 source-only conditional angular-reuse feasibility and complete charged-bound review.** Reconcile current ownership on a new branch, prove a structural admission/storage/lifetime design and every added/induced cost, then require independent authority review before any separately declared implementation. Preserve C043's rejected cold counterexamples. No failed tail may be resumed.

All C044 product, packaging and reviewer execution windows are closed; reviewers are paused and C044 ownership is released. No main lease was acquired or remains held by C044. **Original28 remains 24/28; P11/P16/P23/L03 remain capped; C035 remains held including adverse L03 timing.** Formal input closure, complete delivery/compatibility/independent roles, release integration and the larger GOAL remain open.
